method: High-precision deterministic screens over complete fixed50 outputs; categories are proxies and can miss subtler prose. Blind model-judge G and tags are reported separately.

rules.direct_theme_explanation_proxy: Explicit this song/poem is about or the theme/emotion is framing.
rules.editor_assistant_meta_proxy: Explicit editorial/assistant phrases such as here is an example or leaving interpretation up to the reader.
rules.explanatory_prose_proxy: Anchored explanation phrases such as the point is, in other words, the first part of the refrain, or this might be why.
rules.narrative_prose_paragraph_proxy: At least two nonblank lines of 25+ words, or one such line when output has at most three nonblank lines.
